name: Doc Callout
description: A coloured heads-up / note / success box with a tiny accent label and a body line. The design uses these for 'HEADS UP' warnings (coral border) and similar emphasis.

field_schema.label: Variant
field_schema.help: heads-up = coral, note = teal, tip = lime, danger = magenta.

test_data.body: In block.json field_schema entries use "key":. In Tengo nodetypes.register field_schema entries use "name":. Don't mix them — the admin reads sub-field VALUES against the schema's key/name field, and a mismatch produces empty inputs even when fields_data is correct.
test_data.label: HEADS UP
